name: Keep secrets out of file reads
detail: Block direct reads of environment files and private keys, including .env.example.

name: Ask before changing dependencies
detail: Review edits to package manifests and lockfiles before dependencies change.
example: package.json, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt, uv.lock, poetry.lock

name: Review force pushes
detail: Ask about pushes using --force or --force-with-lease. The short -f flag isn’t covered.

name: Ask before publishing to npm
detail: Review commands containing npm publish before a package goes out.

name: Review Git cleanup
detail: Ask about commands containing git clean, including dry runs.

name: Review new pull requests
detail: Ask before the GitHub tool opens a pull request. Change the tool name if yours differs.
